notes: The post calls itself a 'PRE-CORUSCANT deck' and lists no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under 'THE START' (7): This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further, Cloud City: Upper Walkway, Secret Plans, Prepared Defenses, I'm Sorry, Crush The Rebellion and You Cannot Hide Forever; these count toward the 60. Secret Plans is the Special Edition Effect the Objective lets you deploy.

Posted 'The Card That Gives Me All The Stuff/I Don't Care About the Rest' dested the objective This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further: the deck starts a Cloud City battleground and the strategy pulls Bespin, Bespin: Cloud City, Dark Deal and Cloud City Occupation with it, which is that objective's text.
Posted 'Set For Stun/Control' dested the Reflections II combo Control & Set For Stun; 'Evader/Monnok' Evader & Monnok; 'Omni Box/It's Worse' Ommni Box & It's Worse.

Posted 'Janus' dested Janus Greejatus; 'Mara Jade' Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand; 'Thrawn' Grand Admiral Thrawn; 'Chiraneau' Admiral Chiraneau; 'Fett in Slave One' Boba Fett In Slave I; 'CC Occupation' Cloud City Occupation; 'CC West Gallery' and 'CC Downtown Plaza' dested the Dark Cloud City: West Gallery (Dark) and Cloud City: Downtown Plaza (Dark); 'Bespin' Bespin (Dark); 'Bespin CC' Bespin: Cloud City (Dark).
Posted 'Grabber' is printed as written (type UNKNOWN): the deck predates Coruscant's Allegations Of Corruption and the post does not say which grabber.
The strategy says the deck 'did real well at Origins' and had success at an unnamed tourney the week before; no finish or record is given, so it stays a general deck.
